risks.quote: Ensure that AI systems do not perpetuate or amplify bias and discrimination.
robust safeguards against bias, discrimination, data misuse, and potential harm

responsibilities.quote: All AI projects require an AI Risk Assessment; Medium/High risk mandates Data Privacy Impact Assessment and Ethics review.
Each AI system must have a designated Business Owner accountable for risk assessments, RAAC submissions, documentation, and performance monitoring.
Report AI-related incidents to Legal Services and Data Protection team
All staff and students working with AI must complete the University’s Ethical AI and Data Protection e-module.
Policy updates: Review annually as a minimum, or upon significant legislative, technological or organisational changes.
Maintain human oversight; AI is an augmentation tool, not a replacement for professional judgment.
Design AI systems to be inclusive and usable by people of all abilities.
Protect Rights and Privacy: Adhere to data protection, privacy, and intellectual property laws.
